from itertools import product

# Define all people mentioned in the problem
people = [
    "Mustafa", "Mickey", "Vina", "Phoebe", "Otis", "Oda", "Raymond", "Jerry",

people = sorted(list(set(people)))
person_to_idx = {person: idx for idx, person in enumerate(people)}

def check_constraint(truth_values):
    """
    truth_values: list of boolean values for each person (True = tells truth, False = lies)
    Returns True if all constraints are satisfied
    """
    
    def get_truth(person):
        idx = person_to_idx.get(person)
        if idx is None:
            return False
        return truth_values[idx]
    
    # Pairwise statements: (person_a, person_b, says_truth)
    # where says_truth=True means "A says B tells the truth"
    # and says_truth=False means "A says B lies"
    pairwise_statements = [
        ("Mustafa", "Mickey", False),
        ("Elanor", "Sherrie", True),
        ("Mariah", "Miriam", False),
        ("Mindy", "Natasha", False),
        ("Oda", "Otis", True),
        ("Mickey", "Mustafa", False),
        ("Shenna", "Conception", False),
        ("Ozzy", "Maya", False),
        ("Max", "Odessa", True),
        ("Maria", "Molly", False),
        ("Orin", "Milo", False),
        ("Andree", "Alexis", False),
        ("Mackenzie", "Millie", False),
        ("Orlando", "Octavia", False),

        ("Crista", "Kandi", True),
        ("Mike", "Disha", True),
        ("Octavius", "Oprah", False),
        ("Maya", "Ozzy", False),
        ("Odessa", "Max", True),
        ("Mark", "Opal", False),
        ("Miriam", "Mariah", False),
        ("Malcolm", "Mia", True),
        ("Mia", "Malcolm", True),
        ("Ovid", "Osborne", True),
        ("Muhammad", "Omar", True),
        ("Bahar", "Maynard", False),
        ("Osborne", "Ovid", True),
        ("Milo", "Orin", False),
        ("Otis", "Oda", True),
        ("Natasha", "Mindy", False),
        ("Ophelia", "Uri", True),
        ("Opal", "Mark", False),
        ("Murphy", "Osric", True),
        ("Matteo", "Molly", True),
        ("Millie", "Mackenzie", False),
        ("Octavia", "Orlando", False),
        ("Maynard", "Bahar", False),
        ("Omar", "Muhammad", True),
        ("Melanie", "Martha", True),
        ("Mariana", "Martha", False),
        ("Uri", "Ophelia", True),
        ("Alexis", "Jamey", True),
        ("Disha", "Mike", True),
        ("Millicent", "Oleg", True),
        ("Osric", "Murphy", True),
        ("Sima", "Delbert", False),
        ("Lorine", "Bernita", True),
    ]
    
    for person_a, person_b, says_truth in pairwise_statements:
        truth_a = get_truth(person_a)
        truth_b = get_truth(person_b)
        
        if says_truth:
            statement_is_true = truth_b
        else:
            statement_is_true = not truth_b
        
        if statement_is_true != truth_a:
            return False
    
    # Amberly lies (direct statement)
    if get_truth("Amberly") != False:
        return False
    
    # Complex constraints
    
    # Vina: exactly two of {Phoebe, Otis, Oda} tell truth or none
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Phoebe", "Otis", "Oda"]])
    if (count == 2 or count == 0) != get_truth("Vina"):
        return False
    
    # Raymond: exactly one of {Jerry, Mickey, Mustafa}
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Jerry", "Mickey", "Mustafa"]])
    if (count == 1) != get_truth("Raymond"):
        return False
    
    # Delbert: exactly one of {Sal, Octavia, Orlando}
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Sal", "Octavia", "Orlando"]])
    if (count == 1) != get_truth("Delbert"):

    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Elanor", "Mia", "Malcolm"]])

    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Sima", "Maya", "Ozzy"]])
    if (count == 2) != get_truth("Bernita"):
        return False
    
    # Jamey: exactly one of {Raymond, Bahar, Maynard}
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Raymond", "Bahar", "Maynard"]])
    if (count == 1) != get_truth("Jamey"):
        return False
    
    # Phoebe: all three of {Amberly, Odessa, Max} lie or two tell truth
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Amberly", "Odessa", "Max"]])
    if (count == 0 or count == 2) != get_truth("Phoebe"):
        return False
    
    # Shalonda: exactly two of {Crista, Omar, Muhammad} or none
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Crista", "Omar", "Muhammad"]])
    if (count == 2 or count == 0) != get_truth("Shalonda"):
        return False

    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Shalonda", "Matteo", "Maria"]])
    if (count == 2) != get_truth("Teressa"):

    if (count == 1) != get_truth("Sal"):
        return False
    
    # Ryan: exactly one of {Fidel, Millie, Mackenzie}
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Fidel", "Millie", "Mackenzie"]])
    if (count == 1) != get_truth("Ryan"):
        return False
    
    # Tamika: all three of {Lorine, Disha, Mike} tell truth or only one
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Lorine", "Disha", "Mike"]])
    if (count == 3 or count == 1) != get_truth("Tamika"):
        return False
    
    # Antwan: exactly two of {Ka, Uri, Ophelia} or none
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Ka", "Uri", "Ophelia"]])
    if (count == 2 or count == 0) != get_truth("Antwan"):
        return False
    
    # Yoland: exactly two of {Christie, Osborne, Ovid} or none
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Christie", "Osborne", "Ovid"]])
    if (count == 2 or count == 0) != get_truth("Yoland"):
        return False
    
    # Jerry: exactly one of {Antwan, Oprah, Octavius}
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Antwan", "Oprah", "Octavius"]])
    if (count == 1) != get_truth("Jerry"):
        return False
    
    # Kandi: exactly two of {Shaunda, Mindy, Natasha}
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Shaunda", "Mindy", "Natasha"]])
    if (count == 2) != get_truth("Kandi"):
        return False
    
    # Christie says Teressa lies
    if (not get_truth("Teressa")) != get_truth("Christie"):
        return False
    
    # Fidel: exactly two of {Yoland, Miriam, Mariah}
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Yoland", "Miriam", "Mariah"]])
    if (count == 2) != get_truth("Fidel"):
        return False
    
    # Willian: all three of {Vina, Millicent, Oleg} lie or two tell truth
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Vina", "Millicent", "Oleg"]])
    if (count == 0 or count == 2) != get_truth("Willian"):
        return False
    
    # Conception: exactly two of {Ryan, Milo, Orin}
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Ryan", "Milo", "Orin"]])
    if (count == 2) != get_truth("Conception"):
        return False
    
    # Sherrie: exactly two of {Tamika, Murphy, Osric} or none
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Tamika", "Murphy", "Osric"]])
    if (count == 2 or count == 0) != get_truth("Sherrie"):
        return False
    
    # Ka: only one of {Willian, Melanie, Mariana} lies (exactly two tell truth)
    count = sum([get_truth(p) for p in ["Willian", "Melanie", "Mariana"]])
    if (count == 2) != get_truth("Ka"):
        return False
    
    return True

for values in product([True, False], repeat=len(people)):

    shenna_truth = solution[person_to_idx["Shenna"]]

    print(f"Sherrie tells the truth: {sherrie_truth}")
    print(f"Shenna tells the truth: {shenna_truth}")
    
    tamika_answer = "yes" if tamika_truth else "no"
    sherrie_answer = "yes" if sherrie_truth else "no"
    shenna_answer = "yes" if shenna_truth else "no"
    
    print(f"\nAnswer: {tamika_answer}, {sherrie_answer}, {shenna_answer}")
    
    # Verify all solutions give the same answer
    if len(valid_solutions) > 1:
        print("\nVerifying all solutions...")
        all_same = True
        for sol in valid_solutions[1:]:
            if (sol[person_to_idx["Tamika"]] != tamika_truth or
                sol[person_to_idx["Sherrie"]] != sherrie_truth or
                sol[person_to_idx["Shenna"]] != shenna_truth):
                all_same = False
                break
        if all_same:
            print("All solutions agree on these three people.")
        else:
            print("WARNING: Solutions differ on these people!")
else:
    print("No valid solution found!")
